page.overview:
Who is Honey?

There are two Honey's in Nekomajin, one is Onio's (ex) wife and the other one is Thunderbolt's girlfriend.

Onio's Honey first appears in "Neko Majin Z" with Onio, she does not appear in "Neko Majin Z 2" but is only mentioned by Onio.

According to Toyotarou's interpretation of the prologue of Broly, Honey and Onio were offworld when the Genocide of the Saiyans occurred on Planet Vegeta though they were apparently nearby as they witnessed the explosion from the planet they were on.

Honey and Onio come to the planet earth for their honeymoon and make earth their summer home. When Onio says that it will take him about a month to kill every human without damaging the planet too much, Honey says that he has to leave some slaves for her. Neko Majin Z, who is looking at them from behind some shrubs, thinks that they are tourists and dresses himself up as a koala to get a picture from them. At first Honey and Onio do not want a picture, but Neko Majin Z's friend convinces them when he says that they can show off with it. The friend says that the woman has to hold the koala, making Honey mad, because she is a lady and not a woman. When she held Neko Majin Z, Neko Majin Z squeezes her giant breasts, and Honey and Onio are angry. Onio is so angry even that he goes Super Saiyan. Onio kicks Neko Majin Z away and thinks that he is dead. He starts hugging Honey and says that it is all over now. Neko Majin Z and his friends imitate them, then Onio starts fighting Neko Majin Z and, after a short fight, Onio is defeated and Honey has to drag Onio to their spaceship, forgetting her picture in the process.
